Perl is easy to learn, especially if you have experience in computer programming. Perl was designed to make it easier for users to write and understand, rather than making computers easier to process. The style of natural language is different from other programming languages that use certain grammar and syntax. Perl is, therefore, very flexible and does not impose any specific means of finding a solution or a problem. It can run on any operating system on which Perl Interpreter is installed, which makes it platform-independent. All Linux operating systems are installed with Perl, so you can immediately start Perl encoding on Linux. It is different from shell scripts, where the code changes with the Linux distribution used, making it less and less portable. Small specific tasks in Perl become easy and fast. herel, you will learn how to code small, fast programs for specific tasks. Why learn Perl Scripting? Programmers love Perl because they should make difficult tasks easier without making difficult tasks impossible. It is a simple structure, a clearly defined syntax, and relatively few keywords that allow the student to learn the language in a relatively short time. Debug Perl is relatively easy with its integrated debugger. Perl Features: • Perl uses the best resources from other languages, for example, B. • Perl is connected to external C / C libraries via XS or SWIG. • More than 20,000 third-party modules are available on the complete Perl archiving network. • The Perl interpreter can be integrated with other systems. Perl and the Web: • Perl was the most popular Web programming language due to its text editing capabilities and rapid development cycle. • Perl can process encrypted web data, including e-commerce transactions. • Perl can be integrated on web servers to speed up processing up to 2000%. • With Perl’s mod_perl, the Apache webserver can incorporate a Perl interpreter. • The Perl DBI package facilitates the integration of Web databases. Perl is Interpreted: Perl is interpreted language, which means that your code can be executed unchanged without going through a compilation phase in which a non-portable executable program is created. When you run a Perl program, it is first compiled into bytecode, which is then converted to machine instructions (during program execution). Therefore, it is not exactly the same thing as molds or Tcl, which are interpreted strictly without intermediate representation. Nor is it like most versions of C or C that are compiled directly into a machine-dependent format. Perl File Extension: A Perl script can be created in any normal text editing program. Different programs are available for each type of platform. There are many programs for programmers that can be downloaded from the Internet. File names can contain numbers, symbols, and letters, but they cannot contain spaces.
